slides.h:
5 Excel fixes for
the messy list
someone sent you.

slides.b: Data, Remove Duplicates. Tick the columns that make a row the same. Doubles gone in one click.
Strips the extra spaces you can't see, so the same name stops counting as two people.
Names and phone numbers stuck in one cell? Data, Text to Columns, split on the comma or space.
Turns the list into a table: filters on every column, banded rows, and formulas that fill down by themselves.
View, Freeze Panes, Freeze Top Row. The headings stay put while you scroll 400 rows.

Paste the mess into Toso and say what the sheet is for. Get it finished in Excel, sorted and totalled.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
